summary: Adds internal/mcp/path_escape_test.go: focused regression coverage for the MCP path-escaping guard (formatMCPPathParamValue in internal/mcp/tools.go). Hostile corpus includes slash, dot-segment traversal, encoded traversal, backslash, query characters, hash, unicode, empty, and non-string inputs; asserts no raw slash survives (no path-segment smuggling) and that the escaped value round-trips through url.PathUnescape to the formatted input.
reason: Greptile review scored the PR 4/5 with one request: the security-relevant escaping customization shipped without a focused regression test. The library's triage bot requires 5/5 before maintainer review. Test-only addition; zero behavior change.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes (11 packages); the new test's 11 hostile-input subtests all pass.
